title: त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhishma strikes Parashurama senseless, and Akritavrana revives him. Later Bhishma himself falls from his chariot, and eight radiant Brahmins hold him up in the air and tell him not to fear; the battle resumes.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ಪರಶುರಾಮನನ್ನು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆತಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅಕೃತವ್ರಣನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅನಂತರ ಭೀಷ್ಮನೇ ರಥದಿಂದ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಎಂಟು ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹೆದರಬೇಡ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಯುದ್ಧ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म परशुराम को मूर्च्छित कर देते हैं, और अकृतव्रण उन्हें होश में लाते हैं। बाद में भीष्म स्वयं रथ से गिर पड़ते हैं, और आठ दीप्त ब्राह्मण उन्हें आकाश में थामकर न डरने को कहते हैं; युद्ध फिर आरम्भ होता है।
summary.te: భీష్ముడు పరశురాముని మూర్ఛపోయేలా చేస్తాడు, అకృతవ్రణుడు తేరుకోబెడతాడు. తర్వాత భీష్ముడే రథం నుండి పడిపోతాడు, ఎనిమిది మంది తేజస్వి బ్రాహ్మణులు అతనిని ఆకాశంలో పట్టుకొని భయపడవద్దని చెబుతారు; యుద్ధం మళ్లీ మొదలవుతుంది.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மர் பரஶுராமரை மயங்கச் செய்ய, அக்ருதவ்ரணர் அவரை எழுப்புகிறார். பின்னர் பீஷ்மரே தேரிலிருந்து விழ, எட்டு ஒளிமிக்க அந்தணர்கள் அவரை வானில் தாங்கி அஞ்ச வேண்டாம் என்கிறார்கள்; போர் மீண்டும் தொடங்குகிறது.
summary.ml: ഭീഷ്മർ പരശുരാമനെ ബോധരഹിതനാക്കുന്നു; അകൃതവ്രണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഉണർത്തുന്നു. പിന്നീട് ഭീഷ്മർ തന്നെ തേരിൽനിന്ന് വീഴുന്നു; തേജസ്സുള്ള എട്ടു ബ്രാഹ്മണർ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആകാശത്ത് താങ്ങിപ്പിടിച്ച്, ഭയപ്പെടേണ്ടെന്ന് പറയുന്നു. യുദ്ധം വീണ്ടും തുടരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.183; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रभाते राजेन्द्र सूर्ये विमल उद्गते ।
भार्गवस्य मया सार्धं पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Then at dawn, O king, when the sun had risen bright, the fight between me and Rama of Bhrigu's line began once more.

verses.text:
ततो भ्रान्ते रथे तिष्ठन्रामः प्रहरतां वरः ।
ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि मयि शक्र इवाचले ॥

meaning.en: Then Rama, best of fighters, standing on his whirling chariot, rained showers of arrows on me, as Indra does on a mountain.

verses.text:
तेन सूतो मम सुहृच्छरवर्षेण ताडितः ।
निपपात रथोपस्थे मनो मम विषादयन् ॥

meaning.en: My friend and charioteer, struck by that rain of arrows, fell onto the chariot floor, and my mind sank in grief.

verses.text:
ततः सूतः स मेऽत्यर्थं कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत् ।
पृथिव्यां च शराघातान्निपपात मुमोह च ॥

meaning.en: Then a great faintness overcame my charioteer; he fell to the ground from the blows of the arrows and lost consciousness.

verses.text:
ततः सूतोऽजहात्प्राणान्रामबाणप्रपीडितः ।
मुहूर्तादिव राजेन्द्र मां च भीराविशत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then, tormented by Rama's arrows, the charioteer gave up his life. In a moment, O king, fear came over me too.

verses.text:
ततः सूते हते राजन्क्षिपतस्तस्य मे शरान् ।
प्रमत्तमनसो रामः प्राहिणोन्मृत्युसंमितान् ॥

meaning.en: When the charioteer was killed, O king, and I was shooting arrows with my mind distracted, Rama sent shafts as deadly as Death itself.

verses.text:
ततः सूतव्यसनिनं विप्लुतं मां स भार्गवः ।
शरेणाभ्यहनद्गाढं विकृष्य बलवद्धनुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, as I was reeling from the loss of my charioteer, Rama of Bhrigu's line drew his strong bow hard and struck me deeply with an arrow.

verses.text:
स मे जत्र्वन्तरे राजन्निपत्य रुधिराशनः ।
मयैव सह राजेन्द्र जगाम वसुधातलम् ॥

meaning.en: That blood-drinking arrow fell into the hollow of my collarbone, O king, and I went down to the ground together with it.

verses.text:
मत्वा तु निहतं रामस्ततो मां भरतर्षभ ।
मेघवद्व्यनदच्चोच्चैर्जहृषे च पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Believing me slain, Rama roared aloud like a cloud and rejoiced again and again.

verses.text:
तथा तु पतिते राजन्मयि रामो मुदा युतः ।
उदक्रोशन्महानादं सह तैरनुयायिभिः ॥

meaning.en: When I had fallen, O king, Rama, full of joy, let out a great shout together with his followers.

verses.text:
मम तत्राभवन्ये तु कौरवाः पार्श्वतः स्थिताः ।
आगता ये च युद्धं तज्जनास्तत्र दिदृक्षवः ।
आर्तिं परमिकां जग्मुस्ते तदा मयि पातिते ॥

meaning.en: The Kauravas who stood beside me, and the people who had come to watch that fight, were seized with the deepest grief when I was struck down.

verses.text:
ततोऽपश्यं पातितो राजसिंह
द्विजानष्टौ सूर्यहुताशनाभान् ।
ते मां समन्तात्परिवार्य तस्थुः
स्वबाहुभिः परिगृह्याजिमध्ये ॥

meaning.en: Then, O lion among kings, as I lay fallen I saw eight Brahmins, bright as the sun and fire, standing all around me, holding me up in their arms in the midst of the battle.

verses.text:
रक्ष्यमाणश्च तैर्विप्रैर्नाहं भूमिमुपास्पृशम् ।
अन्तरिक्षे स्थितो ह्यस्मि तैर्विप्रैर्बान्धवैरिव ।
स्वपन्निवान्तरिक्षे च जलबिन्दुभिरुक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: Guarded by those Brahmins, I did not touch the earth; I remained in the air, held up by them as if by kinsmen, and as if asleep, sprinkled with drops of water.

verses.text:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणा राजन्नब्रुवन्परिगृह्य माम् ।
मा भैरिति समं सर्वे स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्विति चासकृत् ॥

meaning.en: Then those Brahmins, holding me, all said together, "Do not be afraid," and again and again, "May you be well."

verses.text:
ततस्तेषामहं वाग्भिस्तर्पितः सहसोत्थितः ।
मातरं सरितां श्रेष्ठामपश्यं रथमास्थिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Revived by their words, I suddenly stood up. Then I saw my mother, the best of rivers, standing in my chariot.

verses.text:
हयाश्च मे संगृहीतास्तया वै
महानद्या संयति कौरवेन्द्र ।
पादौ जनन्याः प्रतिपूज्य चाहं
तथार्ष्टिषेणं रथमभ्यरोहम् ॥

meaning.en: O lord of the Kauravas, that great river had taken hold of my horses in the battle. I honored my mother's feet and climbed into the chariot, which Ashtishena now drove.

verses.text:
ररक्ष सा मम रथं हयांश्चोपस्कराणि च ।
तामहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा पुनरेव व्यसर्जयम् ॥

meaning.en: She protected my chariot, my horses and my equipment. I folded my hands to her and sent her away again.

verses.text:
ततोऽहं स्वयमुद्यम्य हयांस्तान्वातरंहसः ।
अयुध्यं जामदग्न्येन निवृत्तेऽहनि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then I took the reins myself, and with those horses swift as the wind I fought Jamadagni's son on until the day's end, O Bharata.

verses.text:
ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ वेगवन्तं महाबलम् ।
अमुञ्चं समरे बाणं रामाय हृदयच्छिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O best of the Bharatas, I loosed against Rama a swift and mighty arrow that could split the heart.

verses.text:
ततो जगाम वसुधां बाणवेगप्रपीडितः ।
जानुभ्यां धनुरुत्सृज्य रामो मोहवशं गतः ॥

meaning.en: Struck down by the force of that arrow, Rama sank to his knees, dropped his bow, and fell under the sway of unconsciousness.

verses.text:
ततस्तस्मिन्निपतिते रामे भूरिसहस्रदे ।
आवव्रुर्जलदा व्योम क्षरन्तो रुधिरं बहु ॥

meaning.en: When Rama, the giver of thousands of gifts, had fallen, clouds covered the sky, pouring down much blood.

verses.text:
उल्काश्च शतशः पेतुः सनिर्घाताः सकम्पनाः ।
अर्कं च सहसा दीप्तं स्वर्भानुरभिसंवृणोत् ॥

meaning.en: Meteors fell by the hundred, with thunderclaps and tremors, and the planet Rahu suddenly swallowed the blazing sun.

verses.text:
ववुश्च वाताः परुषाश्चलिता च वसुंधरा ।
गृध्रा बडाश्च कङ्काश्च परिपेतुर्मुदा युताः ॥

meaning.en: Harsh winds blew, the earth shook, and vultures, crows and herons flocked about in glee.

verses.text:
दीप्तायां दिशि गोमायुर्दारुणं मुहुरुन्नदत् ।
अनाहता दुन्दुभयो विनेदुर्भृशनिस्वनाः ॥

meaning.en: In the burning quarter of the sky a jackal howled dreadfully again and again, and drums sounded loudly though no one struck them.

verses.text:
एतदौत्पातिकं घोरमासीद्भरतसत्तम ।
विसंज्ञकल्पे धरणीं गते रामे महात्मनि ॥

meaning.en: This terrible omen appeared, O best of the Bharatas, when the great-souled Rama lay on the earth as though unconscious.

verses.text:
ततो रविर्मन्दमरीचिमण्डलो
जगामास्तं पांसुपुञ्जावगाढः ।
निशा व्यगाहत्सुखशीतमारुता
ततो युद्धं प्रत्यवहारयावः ॥

meaning.en: Then the sun, its disc of rays grown faint and sunk in clouds of dust, went down; the night came in with a pleasant cool breeze, and the two of us stopped the battle.

verses.text:
एवं राजन्नवहारो बभूव
ततः पुनर्विमलेऽभूत्सुघोरम् ।
काल्यं काल्यं विंशतिं वै दिनानि
तथैव चान्यानि दिनानि त्रीणि ॥

meaning.en: So the fighting stopped, O king, and began again, terrible, when the day was bright. Day after day it went on for twenty days, and for three more days besides.
